name: Selene Rhythm
about: Modular-style drums: 12 sample banks of 16 variants, 7 live drum synths, and synkit.

modkick.about: modular kick; :0 short and tight … :15 long and boomy

modhat.about: closed hi-hat, 808-style metal; :0 a tick … :15 longer

modtom.about: tom; :0 low floor tom … :15 high tom, so n picks the pitch for fills

modmetal.about: FM metal clang; :0 a tick … :15 a long ring

modzap.about: laser zap, a sine diving down; :0 a blip … :15 a long laser

modperc.about: hand percussion; :0 low … :15 high, even numbers skins, odd numbers woodblocks

modnoise.about: noise; :0-5 snaps, :6-10 falls, :11-15 risers (a riser lasts 0.5-2 s)

syntom.about: live tom; tune with n or note

kit.name: synkit
kit.about: all the live drums under one name: synkit:0 kick, :1 snare, :2 closed hat, :3 open hat, :4 clap, :5 tom, :6 metal, :7 zap; n picks the drum (not the pitch), note tunes it, and the knobs work as on the syn* synths
